text: HH Sport, the Kuwait-based sportswear company, was founded by former Kuwait SC and Kuwait national-team captain Hussain Hakim, who remains its founder and CEO; the company calls itself his brand.
short: HH Sport was founded by and is run by Hussain Hakim.

source.name: HH Sport: About Us
source.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. The same About page says the company is based in Kuwait, was founded in 2015, and lists Al-Fayha FC as a partner club.
